terrainDescription.en: A city-state that's almost entirely urbanized, with only small remaining rainforest reserves (e.g. Bukit Timah)

historicalContext.zh: 前英國殖民地，法律與道路系統深受英式體制影響，未確認為維也納道路標誌公約締約國，四種官方語言使路牌呈現罕見的多文字並列現象。
historicalContext.en: A former British colony whose legal and road systems are deeply UK-influenced; not confirmed as a Vienna Convention on Road Signs party. Its four official languages produce an unusually consistent multi-script signage pattern.
